name: CopyNumberedItem

name: UpdateNumberedItem
evidence: slot 0x54 (update) of class 0x2E: UpdateObjectSet, then, when its world bits allow (MaskWorldBitsBySave), acts on the active switched collider's data block

name: GetNumberedItemFlag

name: ApplyNumberedItemPendingImpulse

name: MarkLevelRecordComplete

name: MarkAllLevelRecordsComplete

name: InitC17Collider

name: StartC17Marker

name: StartC17Collider
evidence: slot 16 (+0x50) of class 0x17: resolves its links (D_0026AA50), starts its three markers (StartC17Marker), creates its state walker, finds the objects of its six reaction lists and picks one of each at random, and chooses its world bit from the save's world bits and the level records

name: HandleC17ColliderActivation
evidence: slot 0x130 of class 0x17, the slot HandleSwitchedColliderActivation fills for 0x05: on activation moves its walker to 0x385 and lists the objects 0x39A or 0x39B and +0x648 at +0x7DC; on release moves it to 0x384, empties the list and, with completion bit 2, queues movie 4 (FadeOutAndQueueMovie)

name: ControlC17Collider

name: HandleC17ColliderNotification

name: UnregisterC71Object

name: StartC71Object
evidence: slot 16 (+0x50) of class 0x71: StartObject, then finds its target by its id (FindFirstObjectById)

name: CopyC71Object

name: RemoveObjectGatherer
evidence: slot 7 of the 0x41 class: runs the base step then removes itself from the world list at +0x1C60 (func_00152600)

name: CopyObjectGatherer
evidence: slot 9 of the 0x41 class: keeps the eight bytes at 0x600 across the base copy func_001BA130

evidence: slot 0x80 (step) of class 0x41: StepCollider, then outside states 1 and 2 passes its placement to func_001B9D10 with the table D_0026ABB0

name: UpdateObjectGatherer
evidence: slot 0x54 (update) of class 0x41: works with the active switched collider, UpdateCollider, and the per-state sounds (StartSoundEffect)

name: RegisterC7CObject
evidence: slot 6 (+0x28) of class 0x7C: RegisterObject, then appends itself to the world's list at +0x1C6C

name: SetC8BObjectVectorFlagged
evidence: sets +0x80 to 1 and stores three floats at +0x54, +0x58 and +0x5C; the script built-in func_00106048 calls it

name: FindNearestAcceptedPointOnSegment
evidence: bisects ten times the segment between the point at +0x90 and a given point for the last place FindPlaneTreeLeafAtPoint accepts, falling back to +0x70, and writes the point, the leaf record and the distance from the given point

name: TrackAimTargetObject

name: TrackAimTargetPoint
